name: cantonlink-community
description: Free, open Cantonese learning content: grammar patterns, topic vocabulary and practice in Jyutping, Yale and Bopomofo.

scripts.check: node tools/format.mjs --check && node tools/build.mjs --check && node tools/check-pronunciation.mjs
